title: Jill Harth Lawsuit Alleged Sexual Assault and Harassment
synopsis: In 1997, former business associate Jill Harth filed a lawsuit alleging sexual assault and harassment by Trump; he denied the allegations and the case later ended. The filing added to a record of misconduct allegations tied to his business relationships.
rationale: Court-filed allegations of sexual misconduct in a business context, denied by Trump.
subcategory: Workplace Sexual Assault and Entertainment Industry Exploitation

title: Miss Universe Moscow: Trump Courted Putin and Agalarov (2013)
synopsis: Ahead of the 2013 Miss Universe pageant in Moscow, Trump courted Russian officials and invited Vladimir Putin while working with developer Aras Agalarov. The episode highlighted early business-driven outreach to authoritarian power centers.
rationale: Shows foreign-policy posture shaped by business incentives and authoritarian outreach.

title: FinCEN Fines Trump Taj Mahal $10 Million for AML Violations
synopsis: FinCEN assessed a $10 million civil penalty against Trump Taj Mahal for willful anti-money-laundering violations, including failure to report suspicious transactions. The order cited repeated compliance failures at the casino.
rationale: Regulatory findings of serious financial compliance violations.

title: Refused to Release Tax Returns During 2016 Campaign
synopsis: Trump broke decades of precedent by refusing to release his tax returns during the 2016 campaign, citing an audit while offering no timeline. The refusal blocked public scrutiny of his finances and conflicts.
rationale: Transparency obstruction during a presidential campaign.

title: Fake Time Magazine Cover Displayed at Trump Tower
synopsis: A fake Time magazine cover praising Trump was displayed at Trump Tower; Time confirmed it was not an authentic cover. The incident reflected manufactured media credibility for branding.
rationale: Fabricated accolades to inflate public image.
subcategory: Media Fraud and False Success Narrative

title: Used Pseudonyms to Hype Wealth to Reporters
synopsis: Reporting revealed Trump used the pseudonyms "John Barron" and "John Miller" to talk to journalists and inflate his wealth and romantic storylines. The tactic aimed to manipulate press coverage and public perception.
rationale: Deliberate media manipulation to fabricate reputation.
subcategory: Media Fraud and False Success Narrative

title: Trump Foundation Veterans Fundraiser Alleged Illegal Coordination
synopsis: New York’s attorney general alleged the Trump Foundation unlawfully coordinated with Trump’s campaign in a 2016 Iowa veterans fundraiser and used charitable resources for political activity. The lawsuit cited illegal coordination and self-dealing.
rationale: Charity misuse and illegal political coordination allegations by state regulators.
subcategory: Charity Fraud and Illegal Political Donations

title: Calls for Death Penalty for Drug Dealers (2018)
synopsis: In a 2018 speech about the opioid crisis, Trump urged the death penalty for drug dealers, praising countries that execute traffickers. The remarks pushed extreme punitive measures into U.S. drug policy debate.
rationale: Advocated expanded capital punishment as policy.

title: Bonwit Teller Art Deco Demolition and Broken Donation Promise
synopsis: During demolition of the Bonwit Teller building for Trump Tower, the building’s Art Deco reliefs were destroyed after earlier assurances they would be preserved or donated. Preservationists said the destruction broke a public promise and symbolized Trump’s willingness to bulldoze cultural heritage for his project timeline.
rationale: A high-profile example of breaking preservation promises for a real-estate project.

title: “I Love the Poorly Educated” Rally Remark
synopsis: After winning the Nevada GOP caucus, Trump told supporters “I love the poorly educated,” a line that drew cheers and became a symbol of anti-intellectual populism during his campaign.
rationale: Celebrated anti-intellectual politics as a badge of honor.

title: “I Alone Can Fix It” RNC Speech
synopsis: Accepting the Republican nomination, Trump declared “I alone can fix it,” presenting himself as a singular savior figure rather than a democratic leader accountable to institutions.
rationale: Authoritarian rhetoric that elevates one leader above democratic checks.

title: Fires FBI Director James Comey
synopsis: Trump abruptly fired FBI Director James Comey, who was overseeing the Russia investigation, triggering accusations of obstruction and an abuse of presidential power.
rationale: Removed the official leading an investigation into his campaign’s Russia ties.

title: Withdraws the U.S. from the Paris Climate Agreement
synopsis: Trump announced the United States would withdraw from the Paris climate accord, rejecting a central global framework for cutting emissions.
rationale: Undermined global climate cooperation and U.S. credibility on emissions cuts.

title: Announces Transgender Military Ban by Tweet
synopsis: Trump declared by tweet that the U.S. would not allow transgender people to serve in the military, abruptly reversing policy and triggering legal challenges.
rationale: Targeted transgender service members and disrupted military policy by fiat.

title: Ends DACA Program for Dreamers
synopsis: The administration announced it would end DACA, the program protecting undocumented immigrants brought to the U.S. as children, jeopardizing hundreds of thousands of Dreamers.
rationale: Revoked protections for a vulnerable population raised in the U.S.
subcategory: Legal Immigration Status Revocation and Humanitarian Protection Elimination

title: Retweets Britain First Anti-Muslim Videos
synopsis: Trump retweeted anti-Muslim videos from the far-right British group Britain First, amplifying extremist propaganda and sparking international backlash.
rationale: Boosted a hate group’s content from the presidential account.

title: “Shithole Countries” Remark
synopsis: In a White House immigration meeting, Trump reportedly referred to Haiti and African nations as “shithole countries,” a remark condemned as racist and degrading.
rationale: Dehumanizing language about countries of color in policy discussions.

title: Withdraws from the Iran Nuclear Deal (JCPOA)
synopsis: Trump announced the U.S. would exit the Iran nuclear agreement (JCPOA), reimposing sanctions and escalating tensions with Iran and U.S. allies.
rationale: Pulled the U.S. out of a multilateral nonproliferation accord.

title: “Take the Guns First, Go Through Due Process Second”
synopsis: At a White House meeting on guns, Trump said authorities should “take the guns first, go through due process second,” endorsing seizures before legal protections.
rationale: Called for bypassing due process rights in gun seizures.

title: U.S. Withdraws from U.N. Human Rights Council
synopsis: The administration announced the U.S. would leave the U.N. Human Rights Council, a move criticized as abandoning global human-rights leadership.
rationale: Withdrew from an international human-rights body.
subcategory: Universal Human Rights Elimination and Constitutional Protection Destruction

title: Revolutionary War “Airports” Gaffe
synopsis: During a Fourth of July speech, Trump praised Revolutionary War troops for “manning the air, it rammed the ramparts, it took over the airports,” a historically impossible claim that drew ridicule.
rationale: Public gaffe showing historical ignorance on a national stage.

title: Floats Buying Greenland
synopsis: Reports said Trump had discussed the idea of the United States buying Greenland, an idea dismissed by Danish officials and widely criticized as a colonial-style fantasy.
rationale: Treating sovereign territory as a real-estate purchase echoed imperialist thinking.

title: Urges China to Investigate the Bidens
synopsis: Trump publicly suggested that China should investigate Joe Biden and his son, inviting foreign interference in a U.S. election.
rationale: Solicited foreign involvement in domestic electoral politics.

title: Announces U.S. Withdrawal from the WHO
synopsis: Trump announced the United States would withdraw from the World Health Organization during the COVID‑19 pandemic, a move criticized for undermining global public-health coordination.
rationale: Pulled out of a key health body in the middle of a pandemic.

title: Suggests Delaying the 2020 Election
synopsis: Trump publicly floated delaying the 2020 election, a proposal widely rejected as unconstitutional and authoritarian.
rationale: Questioned the scheduled democratic transfer of power.
